name: Rogue Runner
description:
About This Game

STOP RUNNING AND YOU DIE.

Rogue Runner is a high-octane blend of Parkour mechanics and TPS Roguelite combat. In a world glitching with infinite improbability, speed is your only ally. Run without slowing down, avoid traps, and eliminate enemies.

Run. Shoot. Evolve. Repeat.

CHAOS IS PROCEDURAL

No two runs are ever the same. The "Machine of Improbability" constantly reshapes the world, generating new map layouts, enemy placements, and trap configurations every time you die. Master the maps to gain an advantage.

CRAFT YOUR ULTIMATE BUILD

There is no “right” way to break this cycle, only your way. Combine different weapons with different skills. Do you want to take out every enemy with a single bullet, empty all your bullets in a second, or go into battle with powerful turrets that will fight for you? The choice is entirely yours.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Fluid Parkour System: Navigate complex environments with wall runs, ziplines, swings, and skiing movements.

  • Global Leaderboards: Don't just survive compete. Run to reach the top spot and show the world your best score.

  • Special Bosses: A unique boss experience awaits you with boss battles designed for the runner mechanic.

A THIEF'S STORY

Alara is a notorious thief who steals dangerous machines. One day, when things go wrong during a heist, she is forced to use the machine she stole. But what she doesn't know is that this machine is a machine of infinite improbability. The machine traps Alara inside its own world of improbability. And the only way out is to break the cycle.
short_desc: Stop running and you die. Combine fluid parkour mechanics with roguelite TPS combat in a procedurally generated world. Master the movement, break the loop, and escape the Machine of Improbability.
